Why they are equivalent for every decimal input of at most nine significant digits: a tie at the eighth significant digit needs a quotient with exactly nine significant digits ending in 5; x = 1/Q is a finite decimal only if Q = 10^k/M with M = 5^c, and the only nine-digit power of 5 is 244140625, whose eighth digit 2 is even, so HALF_EVEN and HALF_DOWN agree. The 28-digit Decimal context cannot create a false tie for such inputs (that needs 19 consecutive zeros or nines, which a remainder over a denominator below 10^9 cannot produce). The carry branch can only tie at 9.9999995, which lies outside that branch.
